sources.source: Redshift docs, Data warehouse system architecture

items.item: A cluster is composed of compute nodes; with two or more, a leader node coordinates them and handles external communication

at.step: Reveal: leader node, compute nodes, slices

items.item: A compute node is partitioned into slices, each allocated a portion of the node's memory and disk space

at.step: Reveal: leader node, compute nodes, slices

items.item: A table can designate one of four distribution styles: AUTO, EVEN, KEY, or ALL, each placing rows differently

at.step: Reveal: four distribution styles

sources.source: Redshift docs, Data distribution for query optimization

items.item: Data redistribution can account for a substantial portion of a query plan's cost, and its network traffic can slow overall system performance

at.step: Reveal: four distribution styles

sources.source: Redshift docs, Working with sort keys and Choose the best sort key

items.item: A table can specify a compound or interleaved sort key, which orders rows; Redshift tracks each block's minimum and maximum values to skip blocks outside a filter's range

at.step: Reveal: sort keys and block skipping

sources.source: Redshift docs, Amazon Redshift provisioned clusters

items.item: RA3 nodes with managed storage let you scale and pay for compute and storage independently, using local SSDs backed by durable S3 storage

at.step: Reveal: RA3 managed storage and Serverless RPUs

sources.source: Redshift docs, Compute capacity for Amazon Redshift Serverless

items.item: Redshift Serverless measures capacity in Redshift Processing Units (RPUs), each providing a fixed amount of memory

at.step: Reveal: RA3 managed storage and Serverless RPUs

items.item: Automatic WLM manages query concurrency and memory allocation; concurrency scaling automatically adds cluster capacity to process a surge of concurrent queries

at.step: Reveal: automatic WLM and concurrency scaling

items.item: Spectrum lets you query and retrieve data from files in S3 directly, without loading it into Redshift tables first

at.step: Reveal: Spectrum and automatic table optimization

items.item: Automatic table optimization continuously observes queries and applies sort and distribution keys without administrator intervention

at.step: Reveal: Spectrum and automatic table optimization
